description: This file defines functions and procedures for managing MBIM protocol configuration and operation within a network interface context, including setup, teardown, and configuration initialization for embedded or Linux-based systems.

methods.name: proto_mbim_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration options for the MBIM protocol, adding string, boolean, and integer configuration parameters.

methods.name: _proto_mbim_get_field
methods.description: Extracts specific fields from MBIM configuration data.

methods.name: proto_mbim_setup
methods.description: Wrapper function that calls the internal setup function and handles retries on failure.

methods.name: proto_mbim_teardown
methods.description: Handles disconnecting and cleaning up the network interface associated with MBIM.
